title: 27 The Old High School · 老高中的夜班

sents.t: "My husband works nights at a high school that was built in 1877.
sents.zh: “我丈夫在一所建于 1877 年的高中上夜班。

sents.t: He's always told me it's been haunted, and he has seen and heard weird stuff.
sents.zh: 他一直跟我说那里闹鬼，他也见过、听过一些怪事。

sents.t: But with the schools being closed since COVID, things have been a little strange recently.
sents.zh: 但自从新冠疫情学校关闭以来，最近情况有点怪。

sents.t: Last night, they had some construction workers in, and one of the guys was freaking out because he said someone kept whispering in his ear.
sents.zh: 昨晚有几个施工工人在学校里，其中一个人吓坏了，因为他说一直有人在他耳边低语。

sents.t: And he didn't seem to believe my husband when he said that the school was haunted.
sents.zh: 而且我丈夫说学校闹鬼时，他好像还不信。

sents.t: Later, one of my husband's colleagues saw something in his peripheral vision a couple of times, so he took a picture where he kept seeing it.
sents.zh: 后来，我丈夫的一个同事有好几次用余光瞥见了什么，于是他朝那个一直看到东西的地方拍了张照片。

sents.t: This is what he caught on camera."
This is that one kid who slept in class and nobody woke up.
sents.zh: 这就是那个在课堂上睡着了、却没人叫醒的孩子。

sents.t: In all seriousness, though, this photo remains a mystery.
sents.zh: 不过说正经的，这张照片至今仍是个谜。

sents.t: But I can't help but think that the history of the school might give an explanation to this image.
sents.zh: 但我忍不住觉得，这所学校的历史也许能解释这张照片。

sents.t: All in all, this photo is pretty creepy.
sents.zh: 总之，这张照片挺吓人的。
